name: OBV
description: This keyword returns the value of the On Balance Volume of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the value of the On Balance Volume of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632222801.png)

You can plot Choppiness Index on any candle of an instrument, like in the above example, you can also plot OBV  of previous (-1) day candle of Nifty 50 futures
